# kapsel-diag golden `multi-error`. Regenerate with KAPSEL_BLESS=1.
# file: script.sh
--- input
false || true
jq . a.json
head -5 a.log
head -n 5 b.log
--- output
error[KS-R001]: `|| true` discards the exit status of `false`
 --> script.sh:1:7
  |
1 | false || true
  |       ^^^^^^^
  |
  = help: handle the failure instead: `false || echo "false failed" >&2`

error[KS-R009]: `jq` is not a kapsel built-in
 --> script.sh:2:1
  |
2 | jq . a.json
  | ^^
  |
  = help: use a built-in (grep, sed, cut), or run `jq` outside kapsel until v0.5

warning[KS-S002]: inconsistent flags for `head`: `-n 5` here, `-5` earlier in the script for the same option
 --> script.sh:4:6
  |
3 | head -5 a.log
  |      -- spelled `-5` here
4 | head -n 5 b.log
  |      ^^^^
  |
  = help: use one spelling throughout; `head -n 5` is the POSIX form

error: refused: 2 errors, 1 warning
